events.title: Dungebra Full Game 1.0.2 - Card Readability Update
events.summary: Card titles now fit their frames, with shorter localized names and corrected Portuguese damage descriptions.Event DescriptionThis update improves card readability in Portuguese, English and Spanish.- Card titles stay on one line and scale within their frames.- Several long localized card names have been shortened.- Two Portuguese damage descriptions now match their cards' actual values.Card effects, damage values and balance are unchanged. Existing full game progress is preserved.

events.title: Dungebra Demo Update - Shop Feedback and Enemy Passive Fixes version 0.1.4
events.summary: Hello, adventurers! We have released a new update for the Dungebra demo focused on shop clarity, combat consistency and small gameplay fixes. This update improves how the shop communicates item states, adds clearer feedback when gold is not enough, and fixes enemy passive behavior during combat.
